description.zh: 开通服务的计费类型。取值为**PayByTraffic**，表示按流量计费。
description.en: The metering method of Alibaba Cloud CDN. A value of **PayByTraffic** indicates that the metering method is pay-by-data-transfer.

descriptions.zh:
- 一个用户只能开通一次，且要求阿里云账号已通过实名认证。
- 单用户调用频率：5次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- Alibaba Cloud CDN can be activated only once per Alibaba Cloud account. The Alibaba Cloud account must complete real-name verification to activate Alibaba Cloud CDN.

- Each account can call this operation up to five times per second.
